target: For every closed oriented spin 4m-manifold, |A-hat(M)| <= 2^m kappa(M).
accepted_conclusions: Spin circle surgery reduces to simply connected manifolds in the same dimension while preserving the index and not increasing kappa.
The universal bound in each fixed dimension 4m>=8 is equivalent to kappa(#^p((K3)^m))=p for all positive p, for an unbounded set of p, and to stable slope one.
Any single defect propagates to every larger p, with the stated quantitative bound.
A normalized witness with a smooth positive-definite C1 limit forces kappa=1 and the known scalar-flat bound.
Metric-uniform one-chirality, reverse-surgery, product-coefficient and numerical-constraint shortcuts have the stated precise scope barriers.
remaining_gap: Prove kappa(#^p((K3)^m)) >= p for every m>=2 and p>=2, equivalently stable slope one, or construct a genuine strict-defect full-block spectral witness.
